1. The task currently lacks any key programming elements such as lists, sets, dictionaries, string manipulation, loops, conditions…

Please include one or more programming elements so that the task is a programming one rather than a purely maths one.

2. Some programming languages available on CodinGame cannot handle arbitrarily large numbers. Please keep output to below 2⁵³.

3. All cases currently provide integers as inputs, not floating-point numbers.

Thanks.
Okay, I'll make the changes. Thanks, boss.
